parsed.explanation: No state bathroom ban, presentation offence or documented police targeting of visitors; courts have enjoined some measures and state hate-crime enhancement exists, giving functioning recourse. Countervailing traveller-facing exposures are national: visa screening for document/sex discrepancy with refusal and possible fraud ineligibility, federal single-sex facility restrictions, passport-marker restrictions and allied advisories, plus severe documented abuse in immigration and federal custody including forced labour, beatings, sexual abuse and hormone removal. Resident-only ID and minor-care bans are not counted as visitor exposure. Local permissiveness is offset by the hostile national border, facilities and custody regime and contested, uneven protections.
